result.description: Optional export receiving the original arguments and completed Node output.

previews.description: MIME types whose captured files can be mounted by the package entry.

renderers.description: Resource pages and their declared creation action.

resources.description: Includes the entry, imported modules and localization resources.

ui_entry.description: Optional module implementing declarative controller contributions.

tools.description: Output presentation for tools provided by this package.
